methods.restart: finite pairs in log h; L-BFGS-B restarted when the completion trigger holds, at most once per pair
methods.squared_gap: finite pairs in t=h^2, 1e-12<=t<=2.25, no restarts
methods.completion: finite pairs in log h; transfer to derivative blocks when the trigger holds; tolerance rechecked after each refit

configuration.boundary: du/dn = g, nonhomogeneous Neumann, manufactured from u*
configuration.objective: integral (0.5|grad u|^2 - f u) - boundary g u + (sigma/2)(integral u - M)^2
configuration.kernel: Gaussian exp(-|y|^2/(2 s^2)) with s=0.45; stable pair columns E cosh z and E (t/s^2) sinhc z
configuration.geometry_bounds: centres [-2,2]^2, angles unbounded, 0<h<=1.5 without positive floor
configuration.coefficient_fit: one linear solve of (S + sigma m m') c = L + sigma M m after column scaling; accepted at residual <= 4 times its rounding floor, otherwise the run stops with status inner_solve_failure
configuration.work_accounting: one unit per distinct coefficient solve, including line-search probes and post-transfer refits
configuration.optimizer: L-BFGS-B ftol0 gtol0 maxcor12 maxls40; memory reset only on completion or, for the restart control, at its matched restarts
configuration.transfer: measured H1 state change at order-64 quadrature; float64, not a validated enclosure
configuration.limitations: fixed Gaussian scale and supplied pairing; no certified objective gate; quadrature agreement is not validated integration
